title: Case 019: Garden Maintenance Request
initial_request:
Hi dear Maintenance team,
As this garden is part of the house included in our tenancy, we would like it to be cleaned and finished properly. The ground also needs to be levelled and covered with stones (gravel) so that we can use the space safely. We would like to sit there in the afternoon, but at the moment it is not possible due to the condition.

I have attached pictures for your reference. Could you please arrange:
• Removal of all rubbish and construction waste
• Levelling of the ground
• Proper gravel/stone covering
• Making the garden safe and usable
overview: The tenant asked for the garden to be cleared of rubbish and construction waste, levelled, covered with gravel or stones, and made safe and usable. The landlord approved removal after the contractor's quote was revised from £500+VAT to around £600 because the material required specialist disposal. The tenant was contacted to confirm access, and a contractor later cleared the garden. The agency told the landlord it would process the invoice and deduct it from the rental amount. The referenced garden pictures and invoice are unavailable.
outcome: The garden was cleared, the landlord was sent the invoice, and the request was closed.
